newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real rises 0.07 pct in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real rises 0.07 pct in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real rose 0.07 percent to close at 1.0792 per dollar in calm trading in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
At 1630 local/1930 GMT, preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a $51 million surplus.
Dealers also attributed the rise in the local currency to the market recovering liquidity after the holiday in Sao Paulo state on Wednesday, which increased the supply of dollars.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0847, up 0.03 percent.
In the parallel market, the real closed unchanged at 1.135.
